statement: Customers shall be able to create an account.
Customers shall be able to search for products by name or category.
Customers shall be able to add products to a shopping cart.
Customers shall be able to place an order using items in their shopping cart.
Administrators shall be able to update product inventory quantities.
Checkout requests shall complete within 3 seconds under normal operating load.
Customer account information shall be protected from unauthorized access.
The storefront shall be available at least 99.5 percent of each calendar month.
The platform shall support growth to 5000 concurrent shoppers.
The checkout interface shall be simple and easy for first-time customers to understand.
Students shall be able to enroll in available courses.
Lecturers shall be able to upload lecture materials for their courses.
Students shall be able to submit assignments electronically.
Lecturers shall be able to publish assignment grades.
Students shall receive a notification when a new grade is published.
The learning platform shall operate on current Windows macOS Android and iOS devices.
Course pages shall load quickly.
The system shall preserve submitted assignments if one application server fails.
The source code shall be organized into modules so that individual features can be modified independently.
The application shall use the university approved visual identity including its logo typography and interface styling.
Customers shall be able to create delivery requests.
Dispatchers shall be able to assign available drivers to deliveries.
Drivers shall be able to update the status of an assigned delivery.
Customers shall be able to view the current status of their delivery.
The system shall notify a customer when a delivery is completed.
The tracking service shall remain operational if a single processing node becomes unavailable.
The platform shall support at least 2000 simultaneously active drivers and customers.
Location updates shall be processed within 5 seconds after they are received from a driver's device.
The mobile application shall be usable in field conditions by drivers with minimal training.
The delivery service shall function properly.
Customers shall be able to view their account balances.
Customers shall be able to transfer funds between their own accounts.
Customers shall be able to download monthly account statements.
Authorized employees shall be able to freeze a customer account.
The system shall record each completed funds transfer in the transaction history.
Financial transaction records shall be retained for the period required by applicable banking regulations.
Online banking sessions shall be protected against unauthorized access.
The online banking service shall be available 24 hours per day except during approved maintenance windows.
The system shall process customer requests in a reasonable amount of time.
The application shall interoperate with the bank's existing payment gateway through its supported interface.
Facility managers shall be able to register building sensors.
The system shall display the latest temperature reported by each registered sensor.
Facility managers shall be able to define temperature alert thresholds.
The system shall notify facility staff when a configured threshold is exceeded.
Facility managers shall be able to disable a faulty sensor.
Sensor monitoring shall continue when one gateway device fails.
The monitoring platform shall support deployment across multiple buildings without redesign.
The system shall be deployable on supported on-premises and cloud environments.
The monitoring service shall be available at least 99.9 percent of the time.
System components shall expose diagnostic information that simplifies fault investigation and maintenance.
Citizens shall be able to create an online service account.
Citizens shall be able to submit permit applications electronically.
Citizens shall be able to upload supporting documents for a permit application.
Government officers shall be able to approve or reject submitted permit applications.
Citizens shall be able to view the status of their submitted applications.
Personal information collected by the portal shall be accessible only to authorized users.
Application records shall be retained in accordance with applicable public-record legislation.
The portal shall follow the government's approved colors typography and visual branding standards.
The citizen portal shall provide clear navigation and understandable instructions for first-time users.
The production system shall maintain documented backup deployment procedures and operational monitoring for critical services.
